user_data_disclosure.data_collection: user-provided API keys and chat messages are transmitted to third-party AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) selected by the user. No data is collected or stored by the extension developer.
user_data_disclosure.data_usage: Chat content is sent to the user-configured AI API endpoint for response generation only.
user_data_disclosure.data_sharing: Data is shared with the AI provider selected by the user (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/local). No data is shared with the extension developer.
